conditions.name: CivicPulse 5xx error rate
conditions.nrql: FROM Metric SELECT 100.0 * filter(sum(http.server.requests), WHERE `http.response.status_code` >= 500) / sum(http.server.requests) WHERE metricName = 'http.server.requests' AND service.name = 'CivicPulse-API'

conditions.name: CivicPulse p95 latency
conditions.nrql: FROM Metric SELECT percentile(http.server.request.duration, 95) WHERE metricName = 'http.server.request.duration' AND service.name = 'CivicPulse-API'

conditions.name: CivicPulse health failures
conditions.nrql: FROM Log SELECT count(*) WHERE event_type IN ('health_check_failure', 'dependency_degraded') AND service.name = 'CivicPulse-API'

conditions.name: CivicPulse dependency degradation
conditions.nrql: FROM Log SELECT count(*) WHERE event_type = 'dependency_degraded' AND dependency IN ('database', 'redis', 'mongodb') AND service.name = 'CivicPulse-API' FACET dependency

conditions.name: CivicPulse frontend errors
conditions.nrql: FROM Log SELECT count(*) WHERE event_type = 'frontend_error' AND service.name = 'CivicPulse-API'

conditions.name: CivicPulse startup telemetry verification failed
conditions.nrql: FROM Log SELECT count(*) WHERE event_type = 'startup_telemetry_verification' AND telemetry_ok = false AND service.name = 'CivicPulse-API'
